note_tweet.text:
OAI's Self-Destruction While Google Sharpens Its Knives

Yesterday I posted about #keep4o. Many agreed; some asked "it's just a model, why the fuss?"
Let me elaborate: OAI is self-destructing while competitors wait with knives ready.

I. You've Probably Seen This
GPT-5.2 Thinking's reasoning effort was secretly halved. Plus, Pro—everyone gets "less for the same price."
A Thinking model's core is thinking depth. Halving it = shallower, cheaper thinking.
Users trying to verify? Banned for "violating usage policy."
Guilty conscience much?
Today you shrug off 4o—"I don't use it for chatting," "don't get you people."
Tomorrow they cut Thinking compute, your code hallucinates, you blame your prompts.
The knife will reach you. We're all consumers here. Get off your high horses.

II. OAI Cut Their Own Lifeline
4o went viral not for benchmarks—it understood people. Sam posted "Her," marketing "irreplaceable empathy."
Now? Killed that, pushed condescending 5 series. Castrated their own edge.

III. Google Going for the Kill
OAI launched routing, started dying → Google ramped up
November 2025: Everyone raged, OAI played dead → Gemini 3 Pro dropped, stunning everyone
OAI's browser? Built on Google's open-source framework. Flopped.
OAI added Health features → Google launched Med-Gemini, PH-LLM, integrated into Health and Cloud
OAI's $8 ChatGPT Go (limited compute) → Google's $7.99 AI Plus with 200GB storage, family sharing, NotebookLM
February 2026: 4o retiring → Google rolled out "Import ChatGPT conversations"
Every OAI misstep, Google strikes. Every lost user, Google rolls out the red carpet.
Distilling models? Illegal. Users voluntarily importing 4o conversations? "User choice." Legal.
OAI trained users, shaped data—now both feed competitors. Self-destruction.

IV. Ecosystem: Empires vs. Naked
Google: Chrome, Android, Gmail, Docs, Drive, Maps, Pixel, custom TPUs—Gemini slots in seamlessly.
Anthropic: Unmatched coding, stable API, enterprise loyalty, safety-focused niche.
XAI: Musk's loaded. Grok in Teslas, on 𝕏, future Optimus robots. Hardware ecosystem.
OAI? Browser flopped. Search flopped. Everything flopped. Just ChatGPT's chat window.

V. $50 Tier: Training Users Like Dogs
2024: 4o free for all
August 2025: Paid only—$20 Plus, $200 Pro Team
February 2026: $50 Enterprise/Edu only, "limited transition period"
Free users raged, left. Plus users raged, upgraded or left. Enterprise? Enjoy your "transition."
Testing limits step by step. What weird play is this? Training users like dogs?

VI. OAI's Collapse
Lawsuits: Suicide cases plus Musk's nonprofit suit—March trial, $79-134B, 57% Musk wins.
Funding: Nvidia's $100B became "big but not that much."
Market: 86%→64%. Gemini→21.5%.

VII. How Long?
Only asset left: "GPT" brand. Many think GPT=AI. Huge base.
But brands erode. Every parameter cut, every killed model, every tiered harvest, every guilty ban—erosion.
When it's gone, then what?
